C1482.title: Meng Dong and He Likang Q Coin Theft Case
C1482.summary: In July 2005, the defendant Meng Dong used a hacking program to steal the account credentials of Maoli Company's online top-up system. Together with He Likang, they stole 32,298 Q Coins and game point cards, with a total value of RMB 25,910.86, and profited by reselling them at low prices.
